selection: For each held-out Moon_7..9 scene, select the valid 20-frame window with the largest recorded future yaw range (degrees rounded to two decimals, tie: earliest anchor); require at least one meter of traveled future path, unique nearest source frames within 125 ms of the 4 Hz grid, and retain previous evaluation windows plus their 4 s exclusion buffer. Selection uses only recorded ground-truth poses, before new inference; no prediction image or prediction quality is used. Frozen anchors: Moon_7=180, Moon_8=39, Moon_9=713.

scenes.validation: All sixteen metric and normalized actions recomputed from recorded GT; timestamps, unique source frames, annotation hashes and prior exclusion buffer verified.
